name: inbox
title: Inbox
description: The notification Inbox: frame with header actions, For you · Updates · Archived tabs, sticky day groups, full-bleed rows grouped per record (stacked actors, a count that expands to the events), inline Allow / Decline or an answered line, J / K triage driving a peek, a fixed right column with the time over the hover actions (read toggle and menu), and empty, loading and error states.

meta.whenToUse: The notifications panel: a feed of person and system events the user reads, acts on and marks read. Put it in a Sheet, Popover or docked panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Toasts for transient confirmations, an activity log on a record (Timeline), or a bare unread count (NotificationBell).
